prompt.original: Use `writing-job-descriptions`. Write a job description for a founding Product Designer at a seed-stage B2B AI startup (6 people, $3M raised) building an AI-powered contract review tool for legal teams. The designer will be the first design hire, working directly with the CEO (former lawyer) and 3 engineers. They need to ship end-to-end (research through pixel-perfect UI) in high ambiguity with no design system yet. Include 12-month success outcomes, a clear design-major spike (information-dense UI + legal workflow), an honest 'what's hard here' section (no design peers, fast pace, ambiguous requirements), and filters that self-select wrong-fit candidates out. Create both a role scorecard and a public job posting. Output: Job Description Pack.
